clue.text: Phone home?

parts.note: the word that goes before phone for a cellphone could also go before home for a caravan-type dwelling; the clue asks for that shared word

explanation.surface: An alien's plea to call home, borrowed from a famous film line.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals that the answer is the word fitting both phrases: a mobile phone and a mobile home.
explanation.definitionFit: A cellphone is called this in Britain, and a mobile home is a movable dwelling.

clue.text: Maybe get false memory?

indicators.note: false says the letters of the words before it are not in their true order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a recollection they hold could be untrue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false' looks like it describes the memory, but it is the anagram signal working on MAYBEGET.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of computer storage of about a million bytes, so an example of memory, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Egghead's colour range largely replacing centre of Bronx

indicators.note: replacing the centre of says the middle letters of the borough name are swapped out for the other piece

parts.note: the Bronx is a borough of New York City

indicators.note: largely means most of the word but not all, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a rainbow is the range of colours in the sky after rain

explanation.surface: A clever person's spectrum of colours is mostly substituting for the middle of a New York borough.
explanation.walkthrough: The centre of the borough is taken as its middle three letters, leaving only the outer B and X. The definition carries the possessive: Egghead's = brainbox is.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British words for a very clever, bookish person, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Races into smallest room for game of chance

indicators.note: into says the races piece goes inside the room piece

parts.note: the smallest room is a jokey British euphemism for the toilet, the loo
the TT races are the Tourist Trophy motorcycle races on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Someone dashes into the toilet on the way to playing a gambling game.
explanation.definitionFit: A lottery-style game where numbers are drawn at random, so a game of pure chance.

clue.text: Restraining orders protecting unruly set from health hazard

indicators.note: protecting means the orders wrap round the other piece as if guarding it

parts.note: ASBOs were British anti-social behaviour orders restraining a person's conduct

indicators.note: unruly says the three letters after it are disorderly and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Court orders keep a rowdy group away from something dangerous to health.
explanation.walkthrough: ASBOs were British court orders curbing antisocial behaviour; 'protecting' looks like part of the legal picture but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A fibrous mineral once used in insulation whose dust causes lung disease, a classic example of a health hazard.

clue.text: Novelist's hilarity at Shakespeare's suicide

parts.note: Will Self is an English novelist; with the possessive his name gives the letters plus S
hilarity is loud amusement, laughter

explanation.surface: A writer finds amusement in the Bard's account of someone taking their own life.
explanation.walkthrough: Will Self is a contemporary English novelist. Hamlet uses the hyphenated form in his 'too too solid flesh' speech.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for killing oneself, used by Shakespeare in Hamlet and Cymbeline.

clue.text: Raised weapon constraining song's eruption

indicators.note: constraining means the weapon piece holds the song piece within it
raised in a down clue means the word is written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: an axe is a weapon
an anthem is a song; the possessive just joins it to what follows

explanation.surface: An upheld weapon holds back a song's outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raised' turns AXE upwards into EXA, which holds ANTHEM: EX-ANTHEM-A.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical term for a skin rash, which doctors call an eruption on the skin.

clue.text: Matters of no consequence right up one Roman street

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
via is the Latin word for a road or street

explanation.surface: Trifling business sends you along a street in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RT, short for right, into TR in this down clue; VIA is Latin for road.
explanation.definitionFit: Trivia are trifling details or facts of little importance, so things of no consequence.

clue.text: Female monarch given the Spanish monetary unit

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a female
K is short for king, a monarch
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A queen is handed a Spanish coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The currency of Israel and an ancient Hebrew coin and weight, so a unit of money.

clue.text: Oversized pair of soldiers

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
a soldier ant is one that guards the colony, so an ant can be a soldier

explanation.surface: A big couple of troopers.
explanation.walkthrough: The two soldiers are a GI and a soldier ant, side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, as in a giant pack, it means enormous, much larger than usual.

clue.text: Stop short before plant gets split up, disastrously

indicators.note: before puts the stopping piece ahead of the plant piece

parts.note: to balk is to stop short and refuse to go on
anise is a plant grown for its aniseed

explanation.surface: Someone halts before a plant that then splits apart catastrophically.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition recalls the break-up of the Balkan states into small hostile ones.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide a region into small mutually hostile states, as happened in the Balkans.

clue.text: A god read about in scripture is sure to rot

indicators.note: in says the rearranged letters sit inside the scripture word

parts.note: the Bible is the Christian scripture

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A divine figure reads around inside holy writ, which is certain to decay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reads like 'concerning' but is the anagram signal; the rearranged eight letters split the scripture after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Material that bacteria and other organisms will break down naturally, so certain to decay.

clue.text: Sociable supplement comprehending our genus

indicators.note: comprehending in its old sense of including means the supplement contains the genus

parts.note: a bonus is an extra payment, a supplement
Homo is the genus to which humans belong

explanation.surface: A friendly extra payment that includes our biological genus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comprehending' is used in its old sense of including or taking in, not understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing good-natured friendliness, from French bonhomie, so a synonym of convivial.

clue.text: 26's last of fruit drink

definitions.note: 26-across is a length of cord; the 's stands for is

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word that follows

parts.note: wine is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: A clue whose answer is the final letter of fruit and a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference points to 26-across: 26's = 26 is. The final letter of fruit is T.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are words for thin cord made of twisted strands, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Head of Treasury meeting worker in Russian Mint — one fomenting unrest?

indicators.note: meeting means the two pieces come together side by side
head of picks the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: someone working in a Russian mint would make roubles, the Russian currency

explanation.surface: A top Treasury official meets someone at the Moscow mint who may stir up trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: A worker at a Russian mint is cryptically a rouble maker; head of Treasury gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: A troublemaker is someone who stirs up discord, which is what fomenting unrest means.

clue.text: Trees hugged by tramps display irregular quality

indicators.note: hugged by means the trees are held inside the tramps

parts.note: bums is American slang for tramps or vagrants
pines are trees

explanation.surface: Vagrants embrace trees, which shows uneven character.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being uneven or rough, like a road full of bumps.

clue.text: Hot sauce summoning up one tear, twice

indicators.note: twice says the assembled piece is written two times
up in a down clue tells us the tear word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a rip is a tear
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A fiery sauce brings up a single tear, then another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'summoning up' turns RIP into PIR in this down clue; with I that makes PIRI, and 'twice' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiery chilli sauce from Portuguese and African cooking, made from small hot peppers.

clue.text: Cook insufficiently good: not a likely winner

parts.note: to underdo food is to cook it too little

explanation.surface: Undercooking is bad, so the chef is not expected to win the contest.
explanation.definitionFit: The underdog is the competitor thought least likely to win.

clue.text: Type of Tory member (registered) involved in seed planting

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up within, so the member and registered pieces go inside

parts.note: a one-nation Tory is a moderate British Conservative; one is written as I
MP is a Member of Parliament
REG is short for registered

explanation.surface: A kind of Conservative politician, duly registered, takes part in sowing.
explanation.walkthrough: One-nation Tories are moderate British Conservatives; with one as I that gives I...NATION, which takes in MP and REG.
explanation.definitionFit: Fertilising or sowing seed, literally or figuratively; impregnation is the act of making pregnant.

clue.text: Dim sow upset by what she lacks?

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A stupid pig is put out because she has no sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'she' refers back to the dim sow, whose lack is good sense, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A dim animal lacks good judgement and knowledge, which is the quality named.

clue.text: Boy pinching a tract from strongman

indicators.note: pinching means holding tightly, so the boy wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: a son is a boy
MS is short for manuscript, a written tract

explanation.surface: A lad steals a pamphlet from a muscleman.
explanation.walkthrough: The insertion falls after the S of SON: S-AMS-ON.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical hero whose great strength lay in his uncut hair, so a byword for a strongman.

clue.text: Latterday Mesopotamian infidel reviled a quiet Israelite for starters

indicators.note: for starters means take the opening letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: A modern unbeliever insulted a quiet Jewish man.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the first two words; the initial letters of the next five spell the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Modern Iraq occupies ancient Mesopotamia, so a present-day inhabitant of that land.

clue.text: Resolve to scatter straw around — and fur

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the straw word is read backwards

parts.note: to ted is to spread out mown grass or straw to dry
ermine is the white winter fur of the stoat

explanation.surface: Someone decides to strew straw about and also use fur.
explanation.walkthrough: To ted is a farming word for spreading hay or straw to dry; 'around' turns it back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: To resolve is to decide firmly, as in resolving to do something.

clue.text: Disprove vegetable growth's reversal

indicators.note: reversal says the vegetable word is read backwards

parts.note: a tuber is a swollen underground growth such as a potato

explanation.surface: A potato's setback overturns an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebut an argument is to refute or disprove it with evidence.

clue.text: Boar's head simmered, stewed and cut up

indicators.note: stewed means cooked into a mess, so the letters are rearranged
head picks the first letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A boar's head is simmered, stewed and carved for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: The first letter of Boar's joins SIMMERED, and 'stewed' rearranges the nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismember a body is to cut it up limb from limb.

clue.text: Unperceptive and overweight in Germany

parts.note: lb, the abbreviation for a pound weight, written over (backwards) gives these two letters
taken as written
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A man who has gained weight in Germany fails to notice things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overweight' looks like one word about being fat, but it is LB, the pound abbreviation, turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cannot see or will not notice what is obvious is figuratively without sight.

clue.text: Senior politician's first to interrupt labourer

indicators.note: to interrupt means to break into the middle, so the first piece goes inside the labourer

parts.note: a miner is a manual labourer
first can be written 1ST, with the figure 1 read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A leading politician is first to break into a workman's speech.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay; 1ST read as IST goes inside MINER.
explanation.definitionFit: A government minister is a senior member of the governing party with a department to run.

clue.text: Undercover operation securing heart of numerical sequence

indicators.note: securing means holding tight, so the operation word holds the middle letter

parts.note: a sting is a covert police operation to catch criminals

indicators.note: heart of picks the central letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: An undercover police operation gets at the core of some figures.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letter of numerical is R, which goes inside STING.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing a string is a sequence of characters, so the words are close synonyms.
